name: Bartleby the Drunk
summary: In the Pig and Whistle Tavern, Bartleby the Drunk faces Harry Burlguard’s test. An aspiring Alliance warrior must take Bartleby’s prized mug before Harry teaches deeper combat skills.

sections.title: A Tavernhouse Test
sections.body: Harry Burlguard asks you to prove your backbone before he teaches deeper combat skills in the Pig and Whistle Tavern. Across the room, Bartleby nurses his drinks at the far end of the counter. Harry wants you to take the man’s mug, knowing Bartleby would rather fight than surrender his ale. The challenge tests your resolve.

sections.title: Old Town Etiquette
sections.body: Soldiers, laborers, and rough locals fill the Pig and Whistle, where polished manners count for little. Bartleby mocks newcomers as too prissy for a tavern scuffle instead of answering politely. The exchange leads to a brawl on the floorboards. In Stormwind, a warrior’s training begins with a test of basic barroom fighting.

faq.answer: Bartleby is an obstinate, heavy-drinking patron at the bar in the Pig and Whistle Tavern, in Stormwind’s Old Town.

faq.q: Why does Harry Burlguard send me to Bartleby?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard wants to see what moves you have before teaching advanced warrior techniques. Taking Bartleby’s mug guarantees a fight and tests whether you can take a punch and hold your ground.

faq.q: Where does this encounter take place?
faq.answer: The encounter takes place inside the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town, on the eastern side of Stormwind City.

faq.q: What happens when you speak to Bartleby?
faq.answer: Bartleby insults you as fancy and prissy, then warns you not to break a nail in the Pig and Whistle. His words quickly spark a fight.

faq.q: What comes after talking to Bartleby?
faq.answer: After you speak to Bartleby, a tavern brawl begins. You must defeat him to claim his mug and return it to Harry Burlguard.

faq.q: Is this quest available to any class?
faq.answer: No. This class training is for Alliance warriors who have reached the tenth level.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face a practical test from Stormwind’s trainers before they teach defensive tactics and stance mastery.
As an Alliance traveler, you see the rough, unglamorous side of Stormwind’s Old Town, far from the royal court of the Keep.
